governance_notes: Full technical and policy control—manage users, courses, plugins, backups, and site settings. Intended for senior staff/IT ops.
Oversees cohorts, assigns mentors, reviews program reports, and manages course-level settings for the program. Not a site admin.

Facilitates sessions, reviews private reflections (mentor-visible), awards mentor-validated points, and files mentor observations for evaluation. Should NOT have site-wide config or backup permissions.
Accesses assigned courses and activities, submits reflections, participates in forum discussion, and views own progress and badges. No access to other learners' private content.
Read-only access to the participant's progress and announcements (opt-in). Cannot view other participants' private reflections or participate in activities.
Manages partner organization cohorts and views organization-level reports. Can assign users to partner cohorts but cannot change site-level configuration.
